verdict.rationale: PlanetScale is a managed database platform. Plugging external MCP servers in so the product can consume their tools is an MCP-client role, which falls outside this product type. The evidence covers only PlanetScale acting as an MCP server (docs-19, docs-44, docs-45) and a PlanetScale Bot that uses PlanetScale's own MCP server (docs-46). Nothing shows the product accepting user-supplied MCP servers, so the wrong-axis exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
